steps.expr: (function(){var cs=deckSlideEl(),SEL='button,a[href],input,select,textarea,[onclick],[role=button],[tabindex]';var vis=function(e){var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<4||r.height<4)return false;var s=getComputedStyle(e);return s.visibility!=='hidden'&&s.display!=='none'&&!e.closest('[hidden]')};var l=[].filter.call(document.querySelectorAll(SEL),function(e){if(e.tabIndex<0||e.disabled||!vis(e))return false;var s=e.closest('.slide');if(s&&s!==cs)return false;return true});var m={};l.forEach(function(e){var k=e.tagName.toLowerCase()+'.'+String(e.className).split(' ')[0]+(e.closest('#rail')?'(rail)':e.closest('#tabs')?'(tab)':'');m[k]=(m[k]||0)+1});return JSON.stringify(m)})()
